## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are DCO-signed (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make test` green
- [ ] Docs updated (and [traceability](../docs/prd/12-traceability.md) if requirements moved)
- [ ] No secrets/PII in records or fixtures
- [ ] If parity-related, [PRD 10](../docs/prd/10-feature-parity.md) updated
